book.title: The Lighthouse Ledger
book.description: A cozy mystery set in a Cornish fishing village. A retired bookkeeper finds a coded ledger in a lighthouse and has to work out which of her neighbours has been hiding money for forty years. Gentle humour, found family, no gore.

Beaton's real name) as signals. Regions are based on Osman, Chesney, McCall Smith and Cleeves. All results were live data, not sample. Celebrity names like Alexander Armstrong, Gyles Brandreth and Greg Jenner came up but are not genre comps, so they are left out. The TV results lean towards British crime drama, so check copy fits a gentler tone.
